attributeDefinition: Date the flight route mission was flown
Name of survey location site. Matches "location" in the other tables in this package.
Channel in which the location lies: LFC (low-flow channel) or HFC (high-flow channel)
Name of the flight route (group of locations) under which the location was flown
Mission number of the flight on that date
Number of redds counted at the location on the flight date. 2025: reported in the flight schedule. 2024: inferred from the number of redd points at the location on that date.
missingValueCodeExplanation: 2024 flight with no redd points on the scheduled date but points the next day; count not assigned

attributeDefinition: How redd_total was obtained: "flight schedule" or "inferred from redd points"
